evidence_type: Original archive member byte hashes plus app source-map sourcesContent SHA256; static not runtime
limits: Byte parity proves shipped content equality, not identical native plugins, permissions, server state or runtime behavior.
A source map sourceContent hash is not by itself proof of source-to-bundle execution equivalence. Pair it with original app bundle/map identity and caller validation.
Source URLs with /./ wrappers and original Vue paths are distinct records.
